BruFin 0.6.2 makes the dashboard and app icon clearer across phone, browser, and homelab use.

- Dashboard summaries and expense controls now adapt more cleanly to narrow phone layouts.
- Income shortcuts are easier to reach by keyboard and show a clear focus indicator.
- The app now uses a simpler, consistent cup mark across the in-app logo, web icon, and Android launcher. Android also has a dedicated monochrome themed icon.
- The README and self-hosting guide explain how to update the app and server while keeping existing data.

This release does not require a database reset or re-import. Install the signed Android APK over the existing app to retain its local data and pairing. When updating the server, keep the existing `brufin-data` volume or `./data` directory attached. If pairing a device for the first time with a server that already has records, choose **Use server data** to keep the server copy.
